sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一名女性的遗体在加利福尼亚州的一处葡萄园被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到了斩首，体内的血液也被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“无名氏”。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字：艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认了她的身份，反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“案件档案呈现”系列的全新节目，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: Mission 61 crew of the Omaha Fire Department were just over an hour into their shift on
sentences.zh: 2013年8月17日星期六，奥马哈消防局第61号任务组的队员们刚开始当天的轮班一个多小时，

sentences.en: Saturday August 17, 2013, when they were called out to a house fire two miles south.
sentences.zh: 就接到了两英里外一处房屋火灾的报警。

sentences.en: Within a matter of seconds, the firefighters had pulled on their safety equipment, raced to their truck, and left the station.
sentences.zh: 几秒钟内，消防员们穿好防护装备，冲向消防车，离开了消防站。

sentences.en: They reached the address five minutes later, arriving at 8.20am.
sentences.zh: 五分钟后，也就是上午8点20分，他们抵达了现场。

sentences.en: The split-level home sat on a quiet street with a small front yard.
sentences.zh: 这是一栋坐落在安静街道上的错层式住宅，前面有一个小院子。

sentences.en: The fire inside was already extinguished, having burnt itself out naturally.
sentences.zh: 屋内的火势已经熄灭，是自然燃尽的。

sentences.en: Inside, the house was smouldering and the air was thick with smoke.
sentences.zh: 屋内余烟袅袅，空气中弥漫着浓重的烟味。

sentences.en: The walls had turned black with soot, and its furnishings were charred beyond repair.
sentences.zh: 墙壁被烟灰熏得漆黑，家具也已烧毁得面目全非。

sentences.en: But there were no embers or flames remaining, and all of the surfaces were cool to the touch.
sentences.zh: 但现场已没有余烬或火焰，所有表面摸起来都是凉的。

sentences.en: It had been some time since the house was ablaze.
sentences.zh: 距离火灾发生已经过去了一段时间。

sentences.en: As the firefighters conducted a thorough search of the property, they discovered something else.
sentences.zh: 当消防员对房产进行彻底搜查时，他们有了新的发现。

sentences.en: There had been several fatalities.
sentences.zh: 现场发生了多起死亡事件。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, an email sat unopened in the inbox of 36-year-old Dave Kruber.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，36岁的戴夫·克鲁伯的收件箱里有一封未读邮件。

sentences.en: It had been sent more than eight hours earlier, at 11.57pm on Friday August 16.
sentences.zh: 这封邮件是在八个多小时前，即8月16日星期五晚上11点57分发出的。

sentences.en: If Dave had clicked on the email, he would have been met with a disturbing claim.
sentences.zh: 如果戴夫点开了这封邮件，他会看到一条令人不安的声明。

sentences.en: I am not lying.
sentences.zh: 我没有撒谎。

sentences.en: I set that nasty whore's house on fire, the message read.
sentences.zh: 我放火烧了那个下贱婊子的房子，邮件里写道。

sentences.en: I hope the whore and her kids die in it.
sentences.zh: 我希望那个婊子和她的孩子死在里面。

sentences.en: Dave Kruber had been out of the dating scene for more than a decade when he suddenly found himself single again.
sentences.zh: 戴夫·克鲁伯在恢复单身前，已经有十多年没有接触过约会市场了。

sentences.en: After 12 years together, he and Amy Flora, the mother of his two children, had decided to split when they realised that they wanted different things.
sentences.zh: 在共同生活12年后，他和两个孩子的母亲艾米·弗洛拉意识到彼此追求不同，决定分手。

sentences.en: Dave was eager to get out there and start seeing new people, but he wasn't ready for anything serious.
sentences.zh: 戴夫渴望走出去结识新朋友，但他还没准备好开始一段认真的关系。

sentences.en: He'd spent most of his adult life in a committed relationship, and here was a chance to have a bit of fun.
sentences.zh: 他成年后的大部分时间都处于一段稳定的关系中，而现在他想找点乐子。

sentences.en: One day, in October of 2012, Dave was working behind the counter of the auto repair shop where he was an assistant manager, when a woman walked in and immediately caught his eye.
sentences.zh: 2012年10月的一天，戴夫正在他担任副经理的汽车修理店柜台后工作，这时一位女士走了进来，瞬间吸引了他的目光。

sentences.en: She was 37-year-old Carrie Farver and had brought in her black Ford Explorer for a minor repair.
sentences.zh: 她就是37岁的嘉莉·法弗，她开着那辆黑色的福特探险者来做小修。

sentences.en: Dave felt a mutual spark of attraction, but was reluctant to do anything about it.
sentences.zh: 戴夫感到两人之间产生了火花，但又有些犹豫。

sentences.en: Asking a customer out didn't seem professional.
sentences.zh: 约客户出去似乎不太专业。

sentences.en: A few days later, he was scrolling through profiles on a dating website when Carrie's photo suddenly popped up.
sentences.zh: 几天后，当他在约会网站上浏览资料时，嘉莉的照片突然弹了出来。

sentences.en: Now he knew for sure she was single and looking to meet someone.
sentences.zh: 现在他确定她是单身，而且正在寻找伴侣。

sentences.en: Dave typed a brief message to Carrie that read,
sentences.zh: 戴夫给嘉莉发了一条简短的信息，上面写着：

sentences.en: Hi, I know you.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我认识你。

sentences.en: Then he hit send.
sentences.zh: 然后他点击了发送。

sentences.en: Carrie sent a polite reply back, and a couple of weeks later she returned to Dave's work to have something else fixed with her car.
sentences.zh: 嘉莉礼貌地回复了，几周后她又回到戴夫的店里修理车子的其他问题。

sentences.en: This time, Dave made his move.
sentences.zh: 这一次，戴夫采取了行动。

sentences.en: The pair exchanged phone numbers and made plans to see each other soon.
sentences.zh: 两人交换了电话号码，并计划很快见面。

sentences.en: Dave and Carrie's first date was on October 29 at an Applebee's restaurant.
sentences.zh: 戴夫和嘉莉的第一次约会是在10月29日，地点是一家Applebee's餐厅。

sentences.en: They hit it off right away, while both agreeing that they weren't looking for anything committed or serious.
sentences.zh: 他们一见如故，同时也达成共识，双方都不想寻找那种承诺或认真的关系。

sentences.en: They went home together that night, and soon they were spending more and more time together.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上他们一起回家，很快他们在一起的时间就越来越多了。

sentences.en: After a couple of weeks, things were comfortable enough for Dave to make an unconventional offer.
sentences.zh: 几周后，两人的关系已经足够融洽，戴夫提出了一个非同寻常的提议。

sentences.en: Dave lived on his own in an apartment in Omaha, Nebraska.
sentences.zh: 戴夫独自住在内布拉斯加州奥马哈市的一间公寓里。

sentences.en: He'd moved to the city to be closer to his children, who lived just across the Iowa state border in his ex-partner's hometown of Council Bluffs.
sentences.zh: 他搬到这座城市是为了离他的孩子们更近，孩子们住在爱荷华州边界对面的前伴侣家乡——康瑟尔布拉夫斯。

sentences.en: Carrie lived in Iowa as well, but her small town of Macedonia was an hour's drive from the IT company in Omaha where she worked as a computer programmer.
sentences.zh: 嘉莉也住在爱荷华州，但她居住的小镇马其顿距离她工作的奥马哈IT公司有一小时的车程，她是一名计算机程序员。

sentences.en: From Monday, November 12, Carrie was required to work late hours on a week-long project, so Dave suggested that she stay with him until she'd met her deadline.
sentences.zh: 从11月12日星期一开始，嘉莉需要为一个为期一周的项目加班，所以戴夫建议她在截止日期前住在他那里。

sentences.en: That way, she wouldn't have to worry about a long commute to and from work.
sentences.zh: 这样，她就不必担心每天往返工作的漫长通勤了。

sentences.en: Carrie was happy with this plan and packed her bags to stay with Dave from that Monday on.
sentences.zh: 嘉莉对这个计划很满意，收拾好行李，从那个周一开始住进了戴夫家。

sentences.en: It was mid-morning on Tuesday, November 13, when Dave heard his phone ding.
sentences.zh: 11月13日星期二上午，戴夫听到手机响了一声。

sentences.en: It was a text message from Carrie that read,
sentences.zh: 那是嘉莉发来的一条短信，写着：

sentences.en: Let's move in together.
sentences.zh: 我们同居吧。

sentences.en: Dave was taken aback.
sentences.zh: 戴夫大吃一惊。

sentences.en: They'd only been dating for two weeks, and he'd been clear that he wasn't looking for a commitment.
sentences.zh: 他们才约会了两周，而且他一直明确表示自己不想做出承诺。

sentences.en: Perhaps inviting Carrie to stay with him for a whole week had given her the wrong message.
sentences.zh: 也许邀请嘉莉住一周让她误解了什么。

sentences.en: He tapped out a reply, explaining to Carrie that he wasn't interested in her suggestion.
sentences.zh: 他敲出一条回复，向嘉莉解释说他对她的建议不感兴趣。

sentences.en: Within seconds, Dave's phone dinged again.
sentences.zh: 几秒钟内，戴夫的手机又响了。

sentences.en: Carrie responded,
sentences.zh: 嘉莉回复道：

sentences.en: Fine, fuck you.
sentences.zh: 行，去你的。

sentences.en: I'm seeing somebody else.
sentences.zh: 我在和别人约会。

sentences.en: Don't contact me again.
sentences.zh: 别再联系我了。

sentences.en: I hate you.
sentences.zh: 我恨你。

sentences.en: Go away.
sentences.zh: 滚开。

sentences.en: Repulsed and annoyed, Dave put his phone away.
sentences.zh: 戴夫感到厌恶和恼火，把手机收了起来。

sentences.en: He'd thought Carrie was better than that.
sentences.zh: 他本以为嘉莉不是那种人。

sentences.en: Later on, he vented about the situation to some of his colleagues, who were empathetic and shared their own bad dating stories.
sentences.zh: 后来，他向一些同事倾诉了这件事，同事们表示同情，并分享了他们自己糟糕的约会经历。

sentences.en: When Dave returned home that night, Carrie had already packed up her things and left.
sentences.zh: 当戴夫那天晚上回到家时，嘉莉已经收拾好东西离开了。

sentences.en: He told himself now that she'd shown her true colours, he'd definitely dodged a bullet.
sentences.zh: 他告诉自己，既然她露出了真面目，自己绝对是躲过了一劫。

sentences.en: A couple of days passed and Dave moved on, focusing on work instead.
sentences.zh: 几天过去了，戴夫继续生活，转而专注于工作。

sentences.en: It appeared that Carrie had moved on as well.
sentences.zh: 嘉莉似乎也已经走出来了。

sentences.en: Then, all of a sudden, he was hit by a barrage of angry text messages from her.
sentences.zh: 然而突然之间，他遭到了她一连串愤怒短信的轰炸。

sentences.en: One after another, they lit up on his phone.
sentences.zh: 一条接一条，他的手机亮个不停。

sentences.en: Carrie told Dave she was furious and started insulting and abusing him.
sentences.zh: 嘉莉告诉戴夫她非常愤怒，并开始辱骂和攻击他。

sentences.en: Occasionally, she tried calling, but Dave refused to pick up.
sentences.zh: 偶尔她会尝试打电话，但戴夫拒绝接听。

sentences.en: Day after day, the abuse continued.
sentences.zh: 日复一日，这种骚扰持续不断。

sentences.en: Dave struggled to go about his normal life, as the constant notifications on his phone interrupted his shifts at work and his social activities afterwards.
sentences.zh: 戴夫难以维持正常生活，手机上不断的通知打断了他的工作和之后的社交活动。

sentences.en: Dave's email inbox was also flooded with a series of aggressive messages, which seemed to grow increasingly hostile and nonsensical.
sentences.zh: 戴夫的电子邮箱也被一系列攻击性邮件淹没，这些邮件似乎变得越来越充满敌意且毫无逻辑。

sentences.en: Some were downright disturbing.
sentences.zh: 有些内容简直令人不安。

sentences.en: One featured the subject line, watching.
sentences.zh: 其中一封的主题是：看着你。

sentences.en: Carrie claimed to be observing Dave's movements, and she sometimes attached photos she'd taken of his home and car.
sentences.zh: 嘉莉声称在观察戴夫的一举一动，有时还会附上她拍下的戴夫家和车的照片。

sentences.en: One day, Carrie started calling Dave's work and hanging up each time someone answered.
sentences.zh: 有一天，嘉莉开始给戴夫的工作单位打电话，每次有人接听就挂断。

sentences.en: For an entire day, the auto repair shop's phone was tied up with hundreds of these prank calls, preventing customers from getting through, interrupting everyone's work day,
sentences.zh: 整整一天，汽车修理店的电话都被这几百个骚扰电话占用了，导致客户无法打入，打断了所有人的工作，

sentences.en: and infuriating Dave's boss and co-workers.
sentences.zh: 并激怒了戴夫的老板和同事。

sentences.en: Dave almost lost his job over the incident.
sentences.zh: 戴夫差点因为这件事丢了工作。

sentences.en: Dave was stunned.
sentences.zh: 戴夫惊呆了。

sentences.en: He had never experienced anything like this.
sentences.zh: 他从未经历过这样的事情。

sentences.en: Finding himself the target of a non-stop harassment campaign was incredibly distressing.
sentences.zh: 发现自己成为一场无休止骚扰活动的目标，这让他感到极度痛苦。

sentences.en: But, to Dave's horror, he wasn't the only one that Carrie had set her sights on.
sentences.zh: 但让戴夫恐惧的是，嘉莉盯上的不仅仅是他一个人。

sentences.en: Carrie's rage at being rejected by Dave prompted her to go after others in his life, specifically other women who he'd been romantically involved with.
sentences.zh: 嘉莉因被戴夫拒绝而产生的愤怒，促使她去骚扰他生活中的其他人，特别是他曾经有过浪漫关系的女性。

sentences.en: His ex, Amy Flora, who'd been Dave's partner for more than a decade, was on the receiving end of Carrie's anger.
sentences.zh: 他的前任艾米·弗洛拉，那个曾与戴夫相伴十多年的伴侣，也成了嘉莉愤怒的受害者。

sentences.en: Carrie also targeted another woman named Liz Gollier, who Dave had been seeing casually.
sentences.zh: 嘉莉还盯上了另一位名叫莉兹·戈利尔的女性，戴夫曾与她有过随意的交往。

sentences.en: Carrie was aware of Liz after bumping into her one night at Dave's apartment.
sentences.zh: 嘉莉是在某晚在戴夫公寓偶遇莉兹后得知她的存在的。

sentences.en: In text to Dave, Carrie called Liz, quote, a fat, ugly whore.
sentences.zh: 在给戴夫的短信中，嘉莉称莉兹为“一个又胖又丑的婊子”。

sentences.en: One day, not long after the harassment began,
sentences.zh: 骚扰开始后不久的一天，

sentences.en: Dave received a call from Liz, who sounded upset and confused.
sentences.zh: 戴夫接到了莉兹的电话，她听起来很不安和困惑。

sentences.en: She told him Carrie had started texting and emailing her, and Liz wanted to know how Carrie had gotten her contact details.
sentences.zh: 她告诉他嘉莉开始给她发短信和邮件，莉兹想知道嘉莉是怎么弄到她的联系方式的。

sentences.en: Things became even scarier when Liz returned home one day to find that the garage of her split-level rental house had been broken into.
sentences.zh: 更可怕的事情发生了，有一天莉兹回到家，发现她租住的错层式房屋的车库被闯入了。

sentences.en: The thief had stolen some checks Liz kept in there.
sentences.zh: 小偷偷走了一些莉兹放在那里的支票。

sentences.en: Then, on November 23, Liz entered her garage to see a nasty message scrawled on the wall in spray paint.
sentences.zh: 随后，在11月23日，莉兹走进车库，看到墙上用喷漆写着一条恶毒的信息。

sentences.en: It read,
sentences.zh: 上面写着：

sentences.en: Whore from Dave.
sentences.zh: 戴夫的婊子。

sentences.en: Both Liz and Dave subsequently received an email from Carrie in which she bragged about having committed the vandalism.
sentences.zh: 随后，莉兹和戴夫都收到了嘉莉发来的一封邮件，她在邮件中吹嘘自己实施了这次破坏行为。

sentences.en: Concerned that Carrie now knew where she lived,
sentences.zh: 担心嘉莉现在知道了她的住处，

sentences.en: Liz filed a report with the Omaha Police Department.
sentences.zh: 莉兹向奥马哈警察局报了案。

sentences.en: Police officers weren't able to track Carrie down as she'd quit her job for a new role in Kansas.
sentences.zh: 警察无法追踪到嘉莉，因为她已经辞职去堪萨斯州担任新职了。

sentences.en: But some digging into her background revealed that she'd been diagnosed with bipolar disorder some years earlier.
sentences.zh: 但对她背景的一些调查显示，她几年前曾被诊断出患有双相情感障碍。

sentences.en: According to Carrie's mother, she had previously ceased taking her medication on at least one occasion as she disliked the way it made her feel.
sentences.zh: 据嘉莉的母亲说，她至少有一次停止服药，因为她不喜欢药物带来的感觉。

sentences.en: The police officers were familiar with this scenario.
sentences.zh: 警官们对这种情况并不陌生。

sentences.en: It wasn't uncommon for them to see erratic behaviour from individuals with untreated mental illness or disorders.
sentences.zh: 他们经常见到患有未治疗的精神疾病或障碍的人表现出反复无常的行为。

sentences.en: They suspected that Carrie was experiencing some kind of mental health crisis and was stalking her ex as a result.
sentences.zh: 他们怀疑嘉莉正在经历某种心理健康危机，并因此在跟踪她的前任。

sentences.en: Until they could find her and question her about it, there was little they could do to stop it.
sentences.zh: 在找到她并就此事询问她之前，他们几乎无能为力。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Dave Kruper continued to be tormented by Carrie.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，戴夫·克鲁伯继续受到嘉莉的折磨。

sentences.en: By the end of 2012, he was receiving up to 60 emails and text messages from her a day.
sentences.zh: 到2012年底，他每天最多会收到她发来的60封邮件和短信。

sentences.en: It didn't matter if Dave changed his phone number, she always managed to find him again.
sentences.zh: 无论戴夫怎么更换电话号码，她总能再次找到他。

sentences.en: He also tried blocking Carrie's number, but this didn't stop the abuse either.
sentences.zh: 他也尝试过拉黑嘉莉的号码，但这并没有阻止骚扰。

sentences.en: More messages simply came through from new, untraceable numbers.
sentences.zh: 更多的信息只是从新的、无法追踪的号码发过来。

sentences.en: Dave saved each one so he could keep track of them all, naming every phone number after Carrie.
sentences.zh: 戴夫保存了每一条信息以便追踪，并以嘉莉的名字命名了每一个电话号码。

sentences.en: Eventually, he had 18 different Carries saved in his phone.
sentences.zh: 最终，他的手机里保存了18个不同的“嘉莉”。

sentences.en: Carrie also used a wide variety of email addresses to harass Dave.
sentences.zh: 嘉莉还使用各种各样的电子邮箱地址来骚扰戴夫。

sentences.en: Some of them featured handles that incorporated Dave's name, such as KruperCarrie76 and Dave's Girl Carrie.
sentences.zh: 其中一些账号包含了戴夫的名字，比如“KruperCarrie76”和“戴夫的女孩嘉莉”。

sentences.en: Carrie made lots of threats and outrageous claiMs.
sentences.zh: 嘉莉发出了许多威胁和离谱的声明。

sentences.en: She insisted that she was pregnant with Dave's child and that she'd moved into his apartment complex.
sentences.zh: 她坚称自己怀了戴夫的孩子，并且已经搬进了他的公寓大楼。

sentences.en: One evening, Dave was watching television at home when his phone dinged with a notification.
sentences.zh: 一天晚上，戴夫正在家里看电视，手机响了一声提示音。

sentences.en: He glanced down to see a message from Carrie.
sentences.zh: 他低头一看，是嘉莉发来的信息。

sentences.en: I see you in the chair with your feet propped up.
sentences.zh: 我看到你坐在椅子上，双脚翘着。

sentences.en: You're wearing your blue t-shirt.
sentences.zh: 你穿着那件蓝色T恤。

sentences.en: Liz rushed into Dave's home, upset and eager to speak with him.
sentences.zh: 莉兹冲进戴夫家，心烦意乱，急于和他谈话。

sentences.en: However, Dave was irritated by the interruption and asked her to leave as soon as she'd gathered up her possessions.
sentences.zh: 然而，戴夫对这种打扰感到恼火，要求她在取走物品后尽快离开。

sentences.en: Once Liz was out of the apartment, Dave called Carrie and she invited him over to her place.
sentences.zh: 莉兹离开公寓后，戴夫给嘉莉打了电话，她邀请他去她家。

sentences.en: That was the beginning of their two-week relationship.
sentences.zh: 那就是他们两周恋情的开始。

sentences.en: The last time Dave Kruper ever saw Carrie Farver was at around 6.30am on Tuesday, November 13, 2012.
sentences.zh: 戴夫·克鲁帕最后一次见到嘉莉·法弗是在2012年11月13日星期二早上6点30分左右。

sentences.en: Carrie had been sitting on his couch using her laptop, and Dave had kissed her goodbye before leaving for work.
sentences.zh: 当时嘉莉正坐在他的沙发上用笔记本电脑，戴夫吻别了她，然后去上班了。

sentences.en: A few hours later, at 9.54, Carrie's phone was used to log into her Facebook account, and whoever did so unfriended Dave Kruper.
sentences.zh: 几个小时后的9点54分，嘉莉的手机被用来登录她的Facebook账户，登录者删除了戴夫·克鲁帕的好友。

sentences.en: Shortly after, Dave received a strange text from Carrie asking if they should move in together, a question completely at odds with her prior approach to their relationship.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，戴夫收到嘉莉发来的一条奇怪短信，问他们是否应该同居，这个问题与她之前对待他们关系的立场完全矛盾。

sentences.en: When he said no, a torrent of abuse began that would continue for years.
sentences.zh: 当他拒绝后，一场持续多年的辱骂开始了。

sentences.en: Two days later, one of Carrie's supervisors at work received a text from her phone that read,
sentences.zh: 两天后，嘉莉的一位主管收到了一条来自她手机的短信，上面写着：

sentences.en: I won't be coming back.
sentences.zh: “我不会再回去了。”

sentences.en: I'm taking a job in Kansas.
sentences.zh: “我要去堪萨斯州找份工作。”

sentences.en: Sorry for the short notice.
sentences.zh: “抱歉通知得这么仓促。”

sentences.en: I am sending someone out to you to fill the position.
sentences.zh: “我派了个人去接替我的职位。”

sentences.en: Her name is Shanna Gollia.
sentences.zh: “她叫莎娜·戈利尔。”

sentences.en: A few hours later, Shanna Liz Gollia filled out an application for a role at the same company where Carrie had worked.
sentences.zh: 几个小时后，莎娜·莉兹·戈利尔填写了一份申请表，应聘嘉莉工作过的那家公司。

sentences.en: As she had no experience in coding or computer programming, her application was unsuccessful.
sentences.zh: 由于她没有编码或计算机编程方面的经验，她的申请没有成功。

sentences.en: When examining Liz's phone contents,
sentences.zh: 在检查莉兹手机的内容时，

sentences.en: Detectives Dodie and Avis found a photo of a woman bound and duct-taped in the trunk of a car, the same one that Carrie had emailed to Dave as a threat against Liz.
sentences.zh: 多蒂和阿维斯侦探发现了一张照片，照片中一名女子被捆绑并用胶带封住嘴，关在汽车后备箱里，这正是嘉莉发给戴夫作为威胁莉兹的证据的那张照片。

sentences.en: The photo had been snapped on Liz's phone, prompting the detectives to suspect she had taken it of herself.
sentences.zh: 这张照片是用莉兹的手机拍摄的，这促使侦探们怀疑是她自己拍的。

sentences.en: They also found out that the video of Dave's apartment building posted to YouTube in Carrie's name had actually been uploaded from an IP address registered to Liz's home.
sentences.zh: 他们还发现，以嘉莉名义发布到YouTube上的戴夫公寓大楼视频，实际上是从注册在莉兹家里的IP地址上传的。

sentences.en: Detectives Dodie and Avis informed Carrie's mother, Nancy, that they suspected Carrie had met with foul play.
sentences.zh: 多蒂和阿维斯侦探通知嘉莉的母亲南希，他们怀疑嘉莉遭遇了不测。

sentences.en: Relieved that her daughter's case was finally being investigated seriously, Nancy willingly surrendered her cell phone so its contents could be studied as well.
sentences.zh: 南希对女儿的案件终于得到认真调查感到欣慰，她主动交出了自己的手机，以便警方研究其中的内容。

sentences.en: Amongst the numerous texts supposedly sent by Carrie was one explaining that she had sold her bedroom furniture and asking Nancy to let the buyer into her home to collect it.
sentences.zh: 在嘉莉据称发送的众多短信中，有一条解释说她卖掉了卧室家具，并要求南希让买家进屋去取。

sentences.en: A photo of a cheque for $5,000 was attached.
sentences.zh: 随附了一张5000美元的支票照片。

sentences.en: It was signed by Liz Gollier.
sentences.zh: 支票上签的是莉兹·戈利尔的名字。

sentences.en: By late 2015, the detectives had accumulated a lot of circumstantial evidence, but no definitive answers.
sentences.zh: 到2015年底，侦探们已经积累了大量的间接证据，但还没有确切的答案。

sentences.en: Then, on December 4, they got a surprise when Liz Gollier suddenly walked into the Potter-Watermead County Sheriff's Department.
sentences.zh: 然后，在12月4日，莉兹·戈利尔突然走进波特瓦特米县治安官办公室，给了他们一个惊喜。

sentences.en: Liz was there to file a harassment report against Amy Flora, the ex-partner of her former boyfriend, Dave Krupa.
sentences.zh: 莉兹此行是为了举报前男友戴夫·克鲁帕的前伴侣艾米·弗洛拉骚扰她。

sentences.en: According to Liz, Amy had been stalking her via Facebook, and she now suspected Amy was also responsible for the attacks made in Carrie Farver's name.
sentences.zh: 据莉兹说，艾米一直在通过Facebook跟踪她，她现在怀疑艾米也应对以嘉莉·法弗名义发出的攻击负责。

sentences.en: Liz was particularly worried because a pistol that Dave Krupa had acquired for self-defence had suddenly gone missing from his home,
sentences.zh: 莉兹特别担心，因为戴夫·克鲁帕为自卫而购买的一把手枪突然从他家中失踪了，

sentences.en: and she knew that Amy had a key to his property.
sentences.zh: 而且她知道艾米有他房子的钥匙。

sentences.en: The detectives requested permission to download Liz's phone once again, and encouraged her to contact them if she had any further concerns.
sentences.zh: 侦探们请求再次下载莉兹手机里的数据，并鼓励她如果有任何进一步的担忧就联系他们。

sentences.en: A little over 24 hours later, Liz was shot in the leg while walking in Big Lake Park and pointed to Amy Flora as her attacker.
sentences.zh: 24小时多一点后，莉兹在大湖公园散步时腿部中弹，她指认艾米·弗洛拉是袭击者。

sentences.en: A thorough search of the park turned up no sign of the assailant, while investigators quickly established that Amy Flora had been at home with her children at the time.
sentences.zh: 对公园的彻底搜查没有发现袭击者的踪迹，而调查人员很快证实，案发时艾米·弗洛拉正和孩子们待在家里。

sentences.en: As bizarre as it seemed, the detectives began to suspect that the shooting had been committed by none other than Liz Gollier herself.
sentences.zh: 尽管看起来很离奇，但侦探们开始怀疑枪击事件正是莉兹·戈利尔本人所为。

sentences.en: Back in 2013, when investigators had downloaded Liz's phone contents for the first time, it was assumed she was a victim.
sentences.zh: 早在2013年，当调查人员第一次下载莉兹手机内容时，还以为她是受害者。

sentences.en: For that reason, the police had performed a logical download, only acquiring the data that still remained on the device.
sentences.zh: 因此，警方只进行了逻辑下载，仅获取了设备上仍然保留的数据。

sentences.en: Now that they were looking at Liz as a possible suspect, they performed a physical download, which would also give them access to content that had been deleted.
sentences.zh: 现在他们将莉兹视为可能的嫌疑人，于是进行了物理下载，这使他们能够访问已删除的内容。

sentences.en: As an IT expert trawled through the recovered data, puzzle pieces began to click into place.
sentences.zh: 当IT专家仔细查看恢复的数据时，拼图碎片开始拼凑在一起。

sentences.en: An app called Texty had been installed by Liz some time ago, then subsequently deleted.
sentences.zh: 莉兹曾安装过一个名为“Texty”的应用程序，后来又将其删除了。

sentences.en: It had allowed her to send messages and emails from numerous fake accounts set up under Carrie Farver's name.
sentences.zh: 它允许她从以嘉莉·法弗名义建立的众多虚假账户中发送短信和电子邮件。

sentences.en: It also enabled Liz to schedule what time she wanted the messages sent, which explained how Dave and Liz had sometimes received texts from Carrie simultaneously,
sentences.zh: 它还使莉兹能够设定发送短信的时间，这就解释了为什么戴夫和莉兹有时会同时收到嘉莉发来的短信，

sentences.en: while sitting side by side.
sentences.zh: 尽管他们当时就坐在彼此身边。

sentences.en: Liz had also used virtual private networks, known as VPNs, to disguise the IP address that her emails were sent from.
sentences.zh: 莉兹还使用虚拟专用网络（即VPN）来掩盖她发送电子邮件的IP地址。

sentences.en: She had sent tens of thousands of texts and emails to herself, Dave, and any other women whom Dave took an interest in.
sentences.zh: 她给自己、戴夫以及戴夫感兴趣的其他任何女性发送了数以万计的短信和电子邮件。

sentences.en: The IT expert calculated that Liz must have spent between 40 to 50 hours each week impersonating Carrie Farver.
sentences.zh: IT专家计算出，莉兹每周必须花费40到50个小时来冒充嘉莉·法弗。

sentences.en: The investigators decided to put Liz's penchant for sending emails to good use.
sentences.zh: 调查人员决定利用莉兹发送电子邮件的嗜好。

sentences.en: On December 14, 2015, nine days after the shooting in Big Lake Park, they asked Liz to come in for an interview.
sentences.zh: 2015年12月14日，在大湖公园枪击事件发生九天后，他们要求莉兹来接受询问。

sentences.en: Sitting her down in his office, Detective Dodie explained that he needed her help.
sentences.zh: 多蒂侦探让她坐在办公室里，解释说他需要她的帮助。

sentences.en: Some human remains had recently been found and they were believed to belong to Carrie Farver, but they were still waiting for DNA to confirm the match.
sentences.zh: 最近发现了一些人类遗骸，据信属于嘉莉·法弗，但他们仍在等待DNA确认匹配结果。

sentences.en: Liz listened keenly as Detective Dodie explained that all he needed was some evidence to put his case together.
sentences.zh: 莉兹聚精会神地听着多蒂侦探解释说，他只需要一些证据来拼凑他的案子。

sentences.en: Perhaps some evidence that Amy had harmed Carrie.
sentences.zh: 也许是一些艾米伤害了嘉莉的证据。

sentences.en: A few days later, emails started trickling into the detectives' inbox.
sentences.zh: 几天后，电子邮件开始陆续进入侦探的收件箱。

sentences.en: Liz was forwarding messages that appeared to have come from Amy Flora, first confessing to shooting Liz,
sentences.zh: 莉兹转发了一些看起来像是来自艾米·弗洛拉的信息，首先承认了枪击莉兹，

sentences.en: then describing in graphic detail how she had attacked, killed, and disposed of Carrie.
sentences.zh: 然后生动地描述了她是如何袭击、杀害并处理掉嘉莉的。

sentences.en: As they collated these confessions over the next couple of months, waiting for evidence they could use, the detectives contacted Dave Krupa to share their suspicions with him.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几个月里，当他们整理这些供词并等待可以使用的证据时，侦探们联系了戴夫·克鲁帕，与他分享了他们的怀疑。

sentences.en: Concerned that Liz might decide to attack Amy while they were still putting their case together,
sentences.zh: 由于担心莉兹可能会在他们还在整理案情时决定袭击艾米，

sentences.en: the detectives told Dave that he should move back in with Amy and their two children for protection.
sentences.zh: 侦探们告诉戴夫，为了保护安全，他应该搬回去和艾米以及他们的两个孩子住在一起。

sentences.en: But they also had an ulterior motive in making this suggestion.
sentences.zh: 但他们提出这个建议还有另一个动机。

sentences.en: They hoped that seeing Dave with Amy would push Liz to breaking point.
sentences.zh: 他们希望看到戴夫和艾米在一起能把莉兹逼到崩溃的边缘。

sentences.en: Sure enough, when Liz found out that Dave was staying with his ex, she called Detective Dodie demanding to know why Amy hadn't been arrested yet.
sentences.zh: 果然，当莉兹发现戴夫和他的前任住在一起时，她打电话给多蒂侦探，质问为什么艾米还没有被捕。

sentences.en: The detective apologised, explaining that they just didn't have enough evidence tying Amy to Carrie.
sentences.zh: 侦探道歉说，他们只是没有足够的证据将艾米与嘉莉联系起来。

sentences.en: A few hours later, some emails arrived that contained information only someone who'd been close to Carrie could know.
sentences.zh: 几个小时后，收到了一些电子邮件，其中包含的信息只有与嘉莉亲近的人才知道。

sentences.en: They described a yin-yang tattoo on Carrie's thigh, as well as the layout and furnishings of her home.
sentences.zh: 它们描述了嘉莉大腿上的阴阳纹身，以及她家的布局和陈设。

sentences.en: They also specified that Carrie had been attacked in her own Ford Explorer.
sentences.zh: 它们还明确指出嘉莉是在她自己的福特探险者车内遭到袭击的。

sentences.en: On February 25, 2016, after identifying Carrie's blood inside her car, the detectives executed a search warrant for Liz Gollier's apartment while she was at work.
sentences.zh: 2016年2月25日，在确认了嘉莉车内的血迹后，侦探们在莉兹上班时对她的公寓执行了搜查令。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, officers were sent to her workplace to arrest her under the guise of some traffic violations.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，警察被派往她的工作地点，以交通违规为由将她逮捕。

sentences.en: Because it seemed that Carrie had been attacked at Dave Crouper's home in Nebraska, not Pottawatomie County in Iowa, where she was reported missing,
sentences.zh: 因为嘉莉似乎是在内布拉斯加州戴夫·克鲁帕的家中遭到袭击的，而不是在她被报告失踪的爱荷华州波特瓦特米县，

sentences.en: a detective from the Omaha Police Department was brought in to interview Liz.
sentences.zh: 奥马哈警察局的一名侦探被请来审问莉兹。

sentences.en: She denied any knowledge of Carrie's whereabouts or involvement in her disappearance and promptly hired a lawyer.
sentences.zh: 她否认对嘉莉的下落有任何了解，也否认参与了她的失踪，并立即聘请了律师。

sentences.en: At Liz's apartment, police found a black and white shower curtain with the distinctive floral pattern.
sentences.zh: 在莉兹的公寓里，警方发现了一个带有独特花卉图案的黑白浴帘。

sentences.en: It matched one that had been bought at a discount store using Carrie Farver's debit card several days after she was last seen.
sentences.zh: 它与嘉莉·法弗最后一次露面几天后，有人用她的借记卡在一家折扣店购买的浴帘相符。

sentences.en: They also found a digital camera and a red Sony camcorder that had gone missing from Carrie's home.
sentences.zh: 他们还发现了一台数码相机和一台从嘉莉家中失踪的红色索尼摄像机。

sentences.en: On the camera was a brief clip that had been filmed on Sunday November 11, 2012, two days before Carrie went missing.
sentences.zh: 相机里有一段简短的视频，拍摄于2012年11月11日星期日，也就是嘉莉失踪前两天。

sentences.en: The footage showed Carrie filming herself in her house and saying,
sentences.zh: 录像显示嘉莉在家里拍摄自己并说道：

sentences.en: So, Thursday night, apparently somebody here in the whopping metropolis of Macedonia, Iowa decided Max's Explorer was not the right colour.
sentences.zh: “所以，周四晚上，显然有人在马其顿这个爱荷华州的繁华大都市里，觉得马克斯的探险者颜色不对。”

sentences.en: Carrie then took the camera outside and aimed it at her black Ford Explorer, which she was planning on giving to her son, Max.
sentences.zh: 嘉莉随后把相机带到外面，对准了她那辆黑色的福特探险者，她打算把这辆车送给儿子马克斯。

sentences.en: Someone had vandalised the bonnet with white spray paint.
sentences.zh: 有人用白色喷漆毁坏了引擎盖。

sentences.en: Detectives suspected that Liz Gollier was responsible for the attack.
sentences.zh: 侦探们怀疑是利兹·戈利尔干的。

sentences.en: That wasn't the only evidence that she'd been stalking Carrie in the days before her disappearance.
sentences.zh: 这并不是她失踪前几天一直在跟踪嘉莉的唯一证据。

sentences.en: As well as the phone records revealing Liz had called Carrie's home number, two fake Facebook accounts had attempted to add Carrie as a friend right before she went missing.
sentences.zh: 除了电话记录显示利兹曾拨打过嘉莉的家庭电话外，在嘉莉失踪前不久，还有两个虚假的Facebook账号试图加她为好友。

sentences.en: Both claimed to be from Macedonia, the same town as Carrie, but misspelt the town's name in the same distinctive way.
sentences.zh: 这两个账号都声称来自马其顿，也就是嘉莉的家乡，但它们拼写地名时都犯了同一个独特的错误。

sentences.en: Despite the fact that Liz Gollier was obsessed with being the only woman in Dave Kruper's life, detectives discovered that she hadn't even been single when they met.
sentences.zh: 尽管利兹·戈利尔一心想成为戴夫·克鲁珀生命中唯一的女人，但侦探们发现，她在遇见戴夫时甚至还没恢复单身。

sentences.en: In 2010, Liz started dating a man named Eric, not his real name.
sentences.zh: 2010年，利兹开始与一名叫埃里克的男子约会（化名）。

sentences.en: Eric was under the impression that the two were exclusive and was a supportive partner to Liz.
sentences.zh: 埃里克以为两人是排他性的恋爱关系，并一直给予利兹支持。

sentences.en: He helped her out financially, assisted with looking after her two children, and invited them all to move in with him when Liz was evicted from her house in 2013.
sentences.zh: 他不仅在经济上帮助她，还协助照顾她的两个孩子，并在2013年利兹被房东驱逐时，邀请他们全家搬去和他一起住。

sentences.en: When Liz's home burnt down in August of that year, it coincided with a period when she and Dave Kruper weren't seeing each other.
sentences.zh: 同年8月利兹的房子被烧毁时，正好处于她和戴夫·克鲁珀没有来往的时期。

sentences.en: Every time Dave's attention drifted from Liz, an increase in Carrie's stalking activity or an attack against Liz would follow.
sentences.zh: 每当戴夫的注意力从利兹身上移开，随后就会出现嘉莉被跟踪或利兹遭到袭击的情况。

sentences.en: She and the children were already living with Eric when her house was set on fire.
sentences.zh: 当她的房子被纵火时，她和孩子们已经住在埃里克家里了。

sentences.en: Nothing of value was lost in the blaze.
sentences.zh: 大火中没有损失什么贵重物品。

sentences.en: With the exception of Liz's four pets, which included two small dogs that Eric had paid for.
sentences.zh: 除了利兹的四只宠物，其中包括埃里克花钱买的两只小狗。

sentences.en: A couple of months after Carrie father disappeared,
sentences.zh: 在嘉莉失踪几个月后，

sentences.en: Eric had started receiving text messages and emails from someone named Carrie, who claimed to know Liz.
sentences.zh: 埃里克开始收到来自一个叫嘉莉的人的短信和邮件，此人声称认识利兹。

sentences.en: When he asked Liz about the matter, she confirmed that Carrie was her friend.
sentences.zh: 当他向利兹询问此事时，利兹确认嘉莉是她的朋友。

sentences.en: Eric eventually grew tired of Liz, who was cruel and made fun of him behind his back.
sentences.zh: 埃里克最终厌倦了利兹，因为她为人刻薄，总是在背后嘲笑他。

sentences.en: He ended their relationship and she moved out of his house at the end of 2015, around the same time that she was shot.
sentences.zh: 他结束了他们的关系，她在2015年底搬出了他的房子，大约就在她被枪击的同一时间。

sentences.en: While Liz was living under Eric's roof, she used his Wi-Fi and some of his electronic devices.
sentences.zh: 利兹住在埃里克家时，使用了他的Wi-Fi和一些电子设备。

sentences.en: As it happened, Eric was employed by Potter-Watermy County's IT department and reported to the same expert who had investigated Liz's phone data.
sentences.zh: 碰巧的是，埃里克受雇于波特-沃特米县的IT部门，他的上司正是调查利兹电话数据的专家。

sentences.en: This meant his computer system was linked to the county's network and law enforcement could access long-term records of his household's internet activity.
sentences.zh: 这意味着他的电脑系统与县里的网络相连，执法部门可以获取他家长期以来的互联网活动记录。

sentences.en: Detectives were able to strengthen their case against Liz by tracing exactly what she had done online while connected to Eric's Wi-Fi.
sentences.zh: 侦探们通过追踪利兹连接埃里克Wi-Fi时在网上的确切操作，加强了对她的指控。

sentences.en: Liz Gollier was charged with first-degree murder on Tuesday December 27, 2016.
sentences.zh: 2016年12月27日星期二，利兹·戈利尔被控一级谋杀罪。

sentences.en: Another charge of second-degree arson was added for the crime of burning down her own home.
sentences.zh: 此外，她还因烧毁自己的房子而被加控二级纵火罪。

sentences.en: Her lawyer publicly defended Liz in the press, explaining that without Carrie Farver's body, investigators really had no proof that she wasn't still alive somewhere.
sentences.zh: 她的律师在媒体上公开为利兹辩护，解释说由于没有找到嘉莉·法弗的尸体，调查人员实际上没有证据证明她已经不在人世了。

sentences.en: Investigators had repeatedly asked Dave Kruper if he had any additional electronic devices that they could look at for evidence, but he couldn't think of any.
sentences.zh: 调查人员曾多次询问戴夫·克鲁珀是否还有其他可以作为证据的电子设备，但他想不起来了。

sentences.en: Then, in early 2017, he suddenly remembered that he had a tablet computer stashed away in storage, which Liz had sometimes used while the two were dating.
sentences.zh: 后来，在2017年初，他突然想起自己存货里有一个平板电脑，利兹在两人交往时偶尔会用。

sentences.en: Dave retrieved the tablet and police found a micro SD memory card inside, which had also been used in Liz's cell phone.
sentences.zh: 戴夫找回了平板电脑，警方在里面发现了一张微型SD存储卡，这张卡也曾被用在利兹的手机里。

sentences.en: The card had been wiped, but through meticulous work, the department's IT expert was able to recover thousands of deleted photographs that had once been stored there.
sentences.zh: 这张卡已被格式化，但通过细致的工作，该部门的IT专家成功恢复了数千张曾经存储在里面的已删除照片。

sentences.en: He scrolled through photo after photo of Liz.
sentences.zh: 他一张接一张地翻看着利兹的照片。

sentences.en: Among the selfies and pictures of her children, he reached some images that were completely different in tone.
sentences.zh: 在自拍照和她孩子的照片中，他看到了一些基调完全不同的图像。

sentences.en: Several showed a blue and grey tarp spread out over an unseen object.
sentences.zh: 其中几张显示一块蓝灰色的防水布铺在一个看不见的东西上。

sentences.en: Another showed what looked like skin with a yin-yang symbol on it.
sentences.zh: 另一张显示看起来像是带有阴阳符号的皮肤。

sentences.en: Then there was a picture of some Chinese characters inked onto what looked like reddish coloured flesh.
sentences.zh: 还有一张照片，上面是一些汉字纹在看起来像是红色的皮肤上。

sentences.en: A forensic expert confirmed that the photograph was of a human foot in the process of decomposition.
sentences.zh: 法医专家证实，照片上是一只正在腐烂的人脚。

sentences.en: When investigators checked with Carrie father's mother, she told them that Carrie had the Chinese word for mother tattooed on her left foot.
sentences.zh: 当调查人员向嘉莉的母亲核实时，她告诉他们，嘉莉的左脚上纹着汉字“母亲”。

sentences.en: It was a perfect match to the characters shown in the photo.
sentences.zh: 这与照片中显示的字符完全吻合。

sentences.en: Detectives later told the ABC television program 2020 how disturbing they'd found the image.
sentences.zh: 侦探们后来在ABC电视节目《2020》中讲述了他们看到这张照片时有多么震惊。

sentences.en: To them, it seemed like a trophy.
sentences.zh: 对他们来说，这看起来像是一个战利品。

sentences.en: It was also the crucial piece of evidence that they needed to prove their case.
sentences.zh: 这也是他们证明案件所需的关键证据。

sentences.en: When the defence found out about the evidence, Liz Gollier waived her right to a jury trial, instead opting for a bench trial in which a judge would decide her fate.
sentences.zh: 当辩方得知这一证据时，利兹·戈利尔放弃了陪审团审判的权利，转而选择由法官裁决的庭审。

sentences.en: Her lawyer presented no evidence and Liz Gollier did not testify.
sentences.zh: 她的律师没有提交任何证据，利兹·戈利尔也没有出庭作证。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, the prosecution's case was extensive, relying on numerous witnesses and mountains of evidence, much of it relating to Liz's online activities.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，检方的案件非常详尽，依赖于众多的证人和海量的证据，其中大部分与利兹的在线活动有关。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, May 24, 2017, Shanna Elizabeth Gollier was found guilty on both counts.
sentences.zh: 2017年5月24日星期三，莎娜·伊丽莎白·戈利尔被判两项罪名成立。

sentences.en: She was sentenced to life imprisonment for Carrie's murder and 18 to 20 years for the arson, with the sentences to run consecutively.
sentences.zh: 她因谋杀嘉莉被判终身监禁，因纵火罪被判18至20年监禁，刑期连续执行。

sentences.en: While Carrie's loved ones celebrated upon hearing the verdict,
sentences.zh: 当嘉莉的亲人们听到判决结果欢呼雀跃时，

sentences.en: Liz Gollier turned red and closed her eyes as she was escorted from the courtroom.
sentences.zh: 利兹·戈利尔在被带离法庭时脸色涨红，闭上了眼睛。

sentences.en: In 2020, author Leslie Rule, the daughter of famed true crime writer Anne Rule, published a book about the case titled A Tangled Web.
sentences.zh: 2020年，著名真实犯罪作家安·鲁尔的女儿、作家莱斯利·鲁尔出版了一本关于此案的书，名为《纠缠的网》。

sentences.en: In researching Liz Gollier's background and early life, Rule made some troubling discoveries.
sentences.zh: 在研究利兹·戈利尔的背景和早年生活时，鲁尔有一些令人不安的发现。

sentences.en: After losing her entire family at a very young age and experiencing a difficult upbringing in the foster care system, Liz married and was divorced by age 22.
sentences.zh: 在很小的时候就失去了整个家庭，并在寄养系统中度过了艰难的成长岁月后，利兹在22岁时结婚并离婚。

sentences.en: At 23, she gave birth to her first child, a boy she named Cody Gollier.
sentences.zh: 23岁时，她生下了第一个孩子，一个名叫科迪·戈利尔的男孩。

sentences.en: Cody cried a lot and members of his extended family thought he seemed like an extremely unhappy baby, but Liz said he was just colicky.
sentences.zh: 科迪经常哭闹，他的大家族成员觉得他看起来是个极其不快乐的婴儿，但利兹说他只是肠绞痛。

sentences.en: One morning, Liz's 21-year-old boyfriend, Neil Munson, who wasn't Cody's father, was looking after five-month-old Cody while Liz was at work.
sentences.zh: 一天早上，利兹21岁的男友尼尔·曼森（并非科迪的生父）在利兹上班时照看五个月大的科迪。

sentences.en: Neil's mother Gloria was helping him and noticed how strangely quiet Cody was.
sentences.zh: 尼尔的母亲格洛丽亚在帮忙时，注意到科迪安静得有些反常。

sentences.en: He remained that way for the entire day.
sentences.zh: 他一整天都保持那样。

sentences.en: At around 5pm, Gloria went to check on Cody and was horrified to discover he wasn't breathing.
sentences.zh: 下午5点左右，格洛丽亚去查看科迪，惊恐地发现他已经没有呼吸了。

sentences.en: An ambulance was called and Cody was rushed to hospital, but he was pronounced dead shortly after.
sentences.zh: 救护车被叫来，科迪被紧急送往医院，但不久后被宣布死亡。

sentences.en: The cause of death was found to be a serious brain injury caused by Cody being forcefully shaken.
sentences.zh: 死因被认定为因被用力摇晃而导致的严重脑损伤。

sentences.en: Neil Munson, who had an intellectual disability, was grilled by investigators for hours.
sentences.zh: 患有智力障碍的尼尔·曼森被调查人员审问了几个小时。

sentences.en: While he admitted to sometimes playfully throwing Cody in the air, he said that the baby had always laughed and enjoyed the game.
sentences.zh: 虽然他承认有时会开玩笑地把科迪抛向空中，但他表示婴儿总是笑得很开心，很喜欢这个游戏。

sentences.en: As the officers continued to press him,
sentences.zh: 随着警官们继续施压，

sentences.en: Neil acknowledged that he might have thrown Cody higher than usual that day.
sentences.zh: 尼尔承认那天他可能把科迪抛得比平时高了一些。

sentences.en: Neil Munson was eventually charged with killing Cody.
sentences.zh: 尼尔·曼森最终被指控杀害了科迪。

sentences.en: But not everyone was convinced that Neil was responsible.
sentences.zh: 但并非所有人都相信是尼尔干的。

sentences.en: When Neil's mother Gloria realised how sick Cody was, she asked Neil if anything strange had happened recently.
sentences.zh: 当尼尔的母亲格洛丽亚意识到科迪病得有多重时，她问尼尔最近有没有发生什么奇怪的事。

sentences.en: He'd mentioned that Liz had called him at work the previous night and told him to hurry home because she'd dropped the baby.
sentences.zh: 他提到利兹前一天晚上在工作时给他打电话，让他赶紧回家，因为她把孩子摔了。

sentences.en: Multiple people in Liz's life, including Cody's father, suspected that she had something to do with the infant's death.
sentences.zh: 利兹生活中的多个人，包括科迪的父亲，都怀疑她与这个婴儿的死有关。

sentences.en: She seemed unusually cheerful in the days after Cody died.
sentences.zh: 在科迪死后的几天里，她看起来异常开朗。

sentences.en: At Neil's trial, he pleaded guilty after a series of incriminating letters emerged that he had supposedly sent to Liz from prison.
sentences.zh: 在尼尔的审判中，在一系列据称是他从监狱寄给利兹的认罪信件出现后，他认罪了。

sentences.en: Dramatic with overwritten flowery prose, the letters declared Neil's undying love for Liz and asked her to say she'd dropped Cody in order to, quote, set me free.
sentences.zh: 这些信件用词华丽、夸张，表达了尼尔对利兹至死不渝的爱，并要求她承认是她摔了科迪，以便“让我重获自由”。

sentences.en: Neil never denied writing the letters, but those close to him believe they were far beyond his capabilities as a writer.
sentences.zh: 尼尔从未否认写过这些信，但了解他的人认为，这些信的内容远超出了他的写作能力。

sentences.en: Author Leslie Rule has attempted to track down the original letters to study their handwriting, pointing out that Liz Gollier is now on the record as someone
sentences.zh: 作家莱斯利·鲁尔曾试图追踪这些原始信件以研究笔迹，并指出利兹·戈利尔现在是有案底的人，

sentences.en: known to forge confessions in another person's name.
sentences.zh: 以伪造他人名义的供词而闻名。

sentences.en: So far, Rule has been unable to find them.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，鲁尔还没能找到这些信。

sentences.en: Neil Munson was paroled after eight and a half years.
sentences.zh: 尼尔·曼森在服刑八年半后获得假释。

sentences.en: He is now a father of two and his family staunchly believes in his innocence.
sentences.zh: 他现在是两个孩子的父亲，他的家人坚定地相信他是无辜的。

sentences.en: For years, Dave Krupa believed he was being stalked by Carrie Farver, a woman who he'd felt connected to from the moment they met.
sentences.zh: 多年来，戴夫·克鲁珀一直以为自己在被嘉莉·法弗跟踪，那个他从见面那一刻起就感到心意相通的女人。

sentences.en: His initial affection for Carrie had turned to hatred before he finally learnt the truth.
sentences.zh: 在最终得知真相之前，他对嘉莉最初的爱慕已经转变成了仇恨。

sentences.en: Upon realising Liz was behind it all, some things finally started to make sense.
sentences.zh: 意识到这一切背后都是利兹在操纵后，有些事情终于说得通了。

sentences.en: Dave recalled one evening he'd returned home late from a local bar and spotted Liz in the dark, army crawling on the ground away from his apartment.
sentences.zh: 戴夫回忆起一天晚上他从当地酒吧很晚回家，在黑暗中看到利兹在地上像军队一样爬行，远离他的公寓。

sentences.en: He called out to her, but she ignored him as she slithered away into the night.
sentences.zh: 他喊了她一声，但她没理会，溜进了夜色中。

sentences.en: As soon as he entered his home, he received a flurry of texts from Liz apologising and explaining that she was drunk and had no idea what she was doing.
sentences.zh: 他一进家门，就收到利兹发来的一连串短信，道歉并解释说她喝醉了，不知道自己在做什么。

sentences.en: The thought that Carrie lost her life because she met him has been too painful for Dave Krupa to process and has left him wracked with guilt.
sentences.zh: 想到嘉莉是因为遇见他才丢了性命，这让戴夫·克鲁珀感到痛苦万分，充满了负罪感。

sentences.en: Dave has given numerous interviews about his experiences with Liz, explaining to author Leslie Rule
sentences.zh: 戴夫就他与利兹的经历接受了多次采访，向作家莱斯利·鲁尔解释说，

sentences.en: that he plans on appearing in every television program that Nancy Rainey does so he can help her share Carrie's story.
sentences.zh: 他计划参加南希·雷尼做的每一个电视节目，这样他就能帮助她分享嘉莉的故事。

sentences.en: Nancy has said Dave is a victim who, just like her daughter, was in the wrong place at the wrong time.
sentences.zh: 南希说戴夫也是受害者，就像她的女儿一样，在错误的时间出现在了错误的地点。

sentences.en: She knows that Carrie would want Dave to forgive himself.
sentences.zh: 她知道嘉莉会希望戴夫原谅自己。

sentences.en: Carrie's son Max is now at university and is following her example by studying computer science.
sentences.zh: 嘉莉的儿子马克斯现在正在上大学，他追随母亲的榜样，学习计算机科学。

sentences.en: A scholarship in Carrie's name has also been established at Iowa Western Community College, her former school, as a way of keeping Carrie's legacy of kindness alive.
sentences.zh: 爱荷华西部社区学院（嘉莉的母校）还设立了一项以嘉莉名字命名的奖学金，以此让嘉莉善良的精神得以传承。

sentences.en: For years Carrie's loved ones were tormented by the knowledge that something terrible had happened to her and whoever was responsible was taunting them.
sentences.zh: 多年来，嘉莉的亲人们一直饱受折磨，因为他们知道她遭遇了可怕的事情，而凶手还在嘲弄他们。

sentences.en: Although they doubted Carrie could still be alive, Liz Gollier's messages sometimes made it impossible to give up hope.
sentences.zh: 尽管他们怀疑嘉莉可能已经不在人世，但利兹·戈利尔发来的信息有时让他们无法放弃希望。

sentences.en: One time, Nancy was told Carrie was waiting for her at a homeless shelter in Omaha.
sentences.zh: 有一次，南希被告知嘉莉正在奥马哈的一家流浪者收容所等她。

sentences.en: Nancy had rushed to the shelter, overjoyed at the thought of seeing her daughter again, but when she arrived, she was told no one there had seen Carrie.
sentences.zh: 南希冲向收容所，想到能再次见到女儿欣喜若狂，但当她到达时，被告知那里没有人见过嘉莉。

sentences.en: In an interview with the Omaha World Herald newspaper, Nancy shared Carrie's hopes for how her life would be celebrated after her passing.
sentences.zh: 在接受《奥马哈世界先驱报》采访时，南希分享了嘉莉对自己去世后希望如何被纪念的愿望。

sentences.en: She wanted to be cremated and thrown to the wind.
sentences.zh: 她希望被火化，骨灰撒向风中。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, Nancy may never be able to do this for her daughter.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，南希可能永远无法为女儿做到这一点。

sentences.en: While pretending to be Amy, Liz Gollier claimed she burned Carrie's remains, then threw them in the garbage.
sentences.zh: 利兹·戈利尔在冒充艾米时声称，她烧毁了嘉莉的遗体，然后把骨灰扔进了垃圾桶。

sentences.en: If this is true, it would be impossible for authorities to recover them.
sentences.zh: 如果这是真的，当局将不可能找回它们。

sentences.en: Although Nancy was upset that she couldn't fulfil Carrie's wish, she was thinking of holding a celebration in her honour, stating,
sentences.zh: 虽然南希因为无法实现嘉莉的愿望而感到难过，但她正考虑为她举办一场纪念活动，并表示：

sentences.en: She would have wanted a party and a big gathering.
sentences.zh: 她会希望有一场派对和大型聚会。

sentences.en: She loved life.
sentences.zh: 她热爱生活。

sentences.en: I just wish she could have had more of it.
sentences.zh: 我只是希望她能拥有更多的时间。
